rVenue.name: Sea Port Group Securities, LLC
rVenue.materialAspects: Scotia Capital (USA) Inc. (SCUSA) routes orders to this venue for further routing and execution. SCUSA does not receive payment for order flow (PFOF) or exchange rebate pass through from this venue. SCUSA pays commission in the form of a fixed rate per contract to this venue which is not based upon order flow volume minimums/maximums, execution quality, or the characteristics and categories of the order flow (i.e., order types). In addition, such arrangements do not include incentive or disincentive benchmarks. Other execution costs incurred are not passed through to SCUSA.
